experience.title: AI & Deep Learning Developer
experience.description: Developed a patient-aware deep learning framework for binary Alzheimer's disease classification using MRI scans from the OASIS dataset. Enhanced EfficientNetV2-S using Squeeze-and-Excitation attention, GeM pooling, and an MLP-based classification head for improved feature representation. Implemented GroupKFold cross-validation, Mixup/CutMix augmentation, and Grad-CAM interpretability to improve robustness and clinical relevance.

experience.title: RAG & NLP System Architect
experience.description: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using semantic vector retrieval for context-aware question answering. Generated dense embeddings using Sentence Transformers and stored them in a FAISS vector database for efficient similarity search. Integrated retrieved contextual information with LLM prompting to improve answer grounding and reduce hallucinations.

experience.title: Automation & NLP Developer
experience.description: Developed an automated pipeline to scrape job postings and extract skill-related information using BeautifulSoup and NLP techniques. Generated embeddings and stored them in a FAISS vector database to enable semantic similarity search and personalized email generation. Reduced manual outreach effort by over 60% through automated cold email workflows.
